sketch:
Observe: same split canvas as AM but the carrier's instantaneous
frequency f_i(t) = f_p + Δf·m(t) is time-varying. Time-domain
shows the "compressed / stretched" waveform; spectrum shows the
Bessel-sideband structure spread over a bandwidth ≈ 2(Δf + f_m)
(Carson). Sliders for Δf (deviation) and f_m. Experiment: hit a
target bandwidth by choosing Δf. Evaluate: given only spectrum,
infer Δf and f_m. Wrinkle: threshold effect — very small Δf
collapses to a narrow-band spectrum.
